attacks.name: Spurned Affection
steps: After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Sap Power|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll, and this character gains that amount of |!power|.

attacks.name: Enthrall
steps: |!wild| |*Slow|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition.
|!wild| |!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.
|!wild| |!wild| |!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Amora‘s Kiss
superPowers.body: |*Action|: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 1 of this character. Move 1 objective token the chosen character is holding to this character. This character is now holding that token. This character cannot hold more tokens than the Crisis specifies.

superPowers.name: Hel Hath No Fury
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 2 or less within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Siren‘s Call
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3 and Advance that character |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Asgardian
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: Enchanting
superPowers.body: When an enemy character targets this character with an attack, it may use its |!mystic| Defense regardless of the attack's type unless the attacking character pays 2 |!power|.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side, and from 5 to 6 on Injured side.
Amora's Kiss now costs an action
Siren's Call is now limited to once per Turn, instead of once per character per Turn.
